title: Evaluating Multiple LLM Generations with Validated Task Coverage
abstract: arXiv:2608.24228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many LLM applications are most useful when they provide several candidate outputs for comparison, validation, or combination. Predominant evaluation settings, however, still focus on individual outputs or reduce multiple samples to a single success or selected answer. This can miss whether the outputs include several genuinely different useful results. We introduce VTC-Bench, a five-domain benchmark for this setting, together with Validated Task Coverage (VTC) as its core evaluation quantity. The benchmark is built from carefully selected real-data tasks where both output quality and task-relevant distinctness can be checked automatically and reproducibly, without model-based judges. VTC measures how many distinct useful results are obtained within $k$ attempts. translated_title: 评估多种LLM生成结果的有效任务覆盖度
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24228v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：许多LLM应用在提供多个候选输出以供比较、验证或组合时最为有用。然而，主流的评估设置仍侧重于单个输出，或将多个样本简化为单一的成功或选定答案。这可能忽略了输出中是否包含多个真正不同的有用结果。我们引入了VTC-Bench，一个针对此场景的五领域基准测试，并以其核心评估量“有效任务覆盖度”（VTC）为基础。该基准由精心选择的真实数据任务构建，其中输出质量和任务相关的差异性可以自动且可重复地检查，无需基于模型的评判者。VTC衡量在$k$次尝试中获得的不同的有用结果数量。跨多个模型和推理设置，该基准得出了与传统评估不同的结论：从单次生成质量来看最强的配置，在覆盖度上可能并非最优。
tldr: 本论文提出VTC-Bench基准和VTC评估指标，用于衡量LLM多次生成中不同有用结果的覆盖度，发现其能揭示传统单次评估无法捕捉的模型性能差异。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VTC-Bench and the VTC metric to measure coverage of distinct useful results across multiple LLM generations, revealing performance differences missed by traditional single-output evaluation.
